The '''Battle of Kaplan Ridge''' was a decisive 1882 battle during the [[Svetian War]].

== Battle ==

The extracted Northern Alliance source identifies Kaplan Ridge as the decisive defeat of Volgastani-Arabogradsk armies during the war. The captioned source image places Theorin troops at the battle, while the broader campaign involved the [[Northern Alliance]], [[Vesperan Empire]] cooperation, the [[Volgastani-Hamed Empire]], and the [[Arabogradsk-Hamed Caliphate]].

== Consequences ==

The defeat weakened the Volgastani-Hamed position and helped force the 1884 settlement, including reparations and the creation of a diplomatic quarter in [[Murah]]. Later Volgastani discontent over humiliation and economic pressure contributed to the [[Volgastani Summer Revolution]].
